motivation.text: Start while the room is quiet. Your effort does not need an audience.

discipline.text: Put your shoes by the door. Tomorrow you will not argue with yourself.

money.text: Quiet savings buy the freedom to say no, and ownership is the slow reward.

mindset.text: Doubt can speak. It just does not get to sign my permission slip.

fact.text: A photon can take thousands of years to escape the sun's core.

books.text: Treat every product as an experiment; measure what customers do, not what they promise.
books.credit: Idea from The Lean Startup by Eric Ries

stoic.text: Hard days train the mind the way steep hills train the legs. Keep climbing.
